answer: Before an agent can vote or route large transfers, it must escrow a uniqueness bond in a public vault and keep that bond locked through a velvet quiet interval: no burst of sibling registrations, no shared funder, and no identical clocks. Standing then opens only as a lotus of independent counterparties, each petal a signed, single-use settlement from a distinct liquidity root. If later tracing shows those petals share one purse, the vault slashes the bond and burns the name. A sybil farm must therefore lock real capital and wait, honestly, once per mask.
